% Invented deck: beamer's default theme declares no section page, and the
% document's own \AtBeginSection sets its outline frame right after each section
% it opens, the contents shaded but for the section in force, and, its optional
% argument empty, none after a starred one; a subsection opens no page, as no
% hook declares one, and the overview lists every unstarred section and
% subsection. Nothing here derives from any private document.
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}

\usetheme{default}
\AtBeginSection[]{\begin{frame}{Outline}\tableofcontents[currentsection]\end{frame}}

\fonts{
  dir = "fonts",
  body = "Open Sans",
}

\title{Sections Behind Hooks}
\author{Pat Placeholder}
\date{}

\begin{document}

\maketitle

\begin{frame}{Overview}
  \tableofcontents
\end{frame}
